headline: AB Enzymes shelf-life enzyme; Barry Callebaut Flavourcode; FDA allergen and colour updates
summary: AB Enzymes launched VERON MaxiFresh to extend baked-goods shelf life, a direct challenge to Puratos freshness improvers that sales teams should be ready to counter.
Barry Callebaut launched its Flavourcode flavour platform and 2027 chocolate trends report, so Belcolade should benchmark both against its own flavour and Taste Tomorrow offers.
FDA updated its allergen labelling FAQs and is revoking some solvents used in colour extracts; US customers and colour suppliers should be checked for impact.
Clean-label sourdough keeps spreading (Hovis three-ingredient range, Toufayan sourdough pita), supporting demand for Puratos sourdough and natural mould-inhibition solutions.
WHO's draft ultra-processed food definition could add reformulation and labelling pressure across bread, cakes and chocolate and is worth tracking.

items.title: Barry Callebaut launches Flavourcode, opening a new chapter in chocolate flavor innovation
items.summary: Barry Callebaut launched Flavourcode, presented as a new platform for chocolate flavour innovation.
items.why: A competitor move in chocolate flavour design; Belcolade should assess how Flavourcode positions against its own cocoa fermentation and flavour offers.

items.title: Exclusive: Barry Callebaut’s 2027 chocolate trends reveal key consumer demands
items.summary: Barry Callebaut published its 2027 chocolate trends report on the consumer demands it expects to shape chocolate.
items.why: A direct competitor's trend outlook that Belcolade should benchmark against Puratos's Taste Tomorrow insights.

items.title: AB Enzymes launches VERON® MaxiFresh to extend shelf life of baked products
items.summary: AB Enzymes launched VERON MaxiFresh, an enzyme to extend the shelf life of baked goods.
items.why: A direct competitor launch in anti-staling enzymes, competing head-on with Puratos's softness and freshness improvers.

items.title: 7 confectionery trends set to dominate 2027
items.summary: FoodNavigator-USA outlines seven confectionery trends for 2027, from multisensory textures and nostalgia to functional treats, premiumisation and sustainability.
items.why: Trend map for Belcolade and fillings teams on where Mars, Mondelēz, Nestlé, Ferrero, Hershey and Lindt are heading.

items.title: Natural mold inhibitors offer bakers stronger shelf-life protection
items.summary: Baking Business reports natural mould inhibitors giving bakers stronger shelf-life protection.
items.why: Clean-label mould inhibition is a core Puratos bakery need; use it to benchmark and position its own natural preservation solutions in the US.

items.title: Whey Protein Based Edible Coating Incorporated with Lactic Acid Bacteria as a Biopreservation Strategy for Bakery Buns
items.summary: Indian study coating buns with whey protein containing bacteriocin-producing L. plantarum or L. fermentum; the L. plantarum coating gave the lowest yeast and mould counts over six days.
items.why: A live-LAB edible coating is a clean-label mould-inhibition idea adjacent to Puratos's bio-preservation and sourdough know-how for bakery buns.

items.title: FDA Updates Food Allergen Labeling FAQs
items.summary: FDA updated its food allergen labelling FAQs.
items.why: US bakery, patisserie and chocolate customers should review the updated FAQs for labelling and cross-contact guidance; Puratos should check its own US product specs.

items.title: Hovis taps into clean-label demand with new three-ingredient sourdough range
items.summary: Hovis launched a three-ingredient sourdough range aimed at clean-label demand in the UK.
items.why: Major UK baker going short-label sourdough confirms demand for clean-label sourdough and enzyme solutions Puratos sells to industrial bakers.

items.title: Effect of Olive Pomace on the Nutritional, Technological, and Sensory Properties of Gluten-Free Sourdough Bread
items.summary: Bulgarian-Italian study adding 5-30% olive pomace to gluten-free rice sourdough bread, raising fibre (to ~15.6 g/100 g DM), phenolics and lipids while tracking texture and sensory quality.
items.why: Upcycled olive pomace is a fibre and antioxidant booster for Puratos's gluten-free and sourdough bakery lines; worth tracking as a clean-label enrichment ingredient.

items.title: Improving Chinese steamed bread quality through Bacillus natto-fermented okara: Associations of biotransformed proteins and dietary fiber with gluten-network organization
items.summary: Study on Bacillus natto-fermented okara used in Chinese steamed bread, linking biotransformed proteins and fibre to gluten-network organisation and quality.
items.why: Fermented okara is an upcycled fibre/protein enricher that could inform Puratos fibre-enrichment and fermentation work for bread.

items.title: Cocoa Bean Shells as a Source of Bioactive Compounds: Extraction, Stabilisation and Application Potential
items.summary: Critical review of recovering polyphenols, theobromine and fibre from cocoa bean shells, covering extraction, stabilisation, safety and regulatory limits.
items.why: Cocoa shell is a by-product of chocolate making; the review gives Belcolade a realistic view of what upcycled shell fibre or extracts can deliver.

items.title: Upcycling Pulse Milling Byproducts into Value-added Bakery Products: Development of Functional Buns
items.summary: Indian study replacing 0-100% wheat flour in buns with lentil milling by-product powder; 40% substitution kept acceptability near control while raising protein and phenolics.
items.why: Pulse milling side-streams are a cheap protein/fibre enricher for buns, relevant to Puratos protein-enrichment and upcycling projects.

items.title: Chocolate as a delivery matrix for cocoa polyphenols: Processing, matrix structure and gastrointestinal fate
items.summary: Review of chocolate as a delivery matrix for cocoa polyphenols, covering processing, matrix structure and digestive fate.
items.why: Useful background for Belcolade on preserving and claiming cocoa flavanols in high-polyphenol or functional chocolate.

items.title: Enhancing the Deformation Resistance of Oleogels Using Monoglycerides Combined with Polyglyceryl Esters of Fatty Acids: A Novel Alternative to Conventional Shortening in Toasts
items.summary: Monoglyceride oleogels combined with polyglyceryl esters formed denser lamellar networks and were tested as a shortening replacement in toast bread.
items.why: A structured oleogel shortening alternative could support Puratos fat-reduction and palm-free fat systems in bread and laminated goods.

items.title: FDA colour additive revocations coincide with WHO scrutiny of food ingredients
items.summary: FDA's revocation of some colour additive authorisations coincides with WHO scrutiny of food ingredients.
items.why: Colour rules are shifting; Puratos patisserie colours, glazes and decorations for the US should be checked against the revocations.

items.title: Toufayan Bakeries Introduces "Simply Sourdough Pita"; Karen Toufayan Comments
items.summary: Toufayan Bakeries launched a Simply Sourdough Pita line in the US.
items.why: Another US industrial baker moving into simple sourdough products, a demand signal for Puratos sourdough (Sapore/O-tentic) solutions.

items.title: Sweet bakery NPD: viral trends and seasonal flavours shape latest launches
items.summary: Roundup of UK sweet bakery launches shaped by viral trends and seasonal flavours.
items.why: Seasonal and viral flavour cues feed Puratos patisserie fillings and flavour roadmaps.

items.title: WHO’s Draft Integrated Food Profiling Model and UPF Definition
items.summary: Michigan State University discusses WHO's draft integrated food profiling model and ultra-processed food definition.
items.why: A WHO UPF definition could shape labelling and reformulation pressure on bread, cakes and chocolate; Puratos should follow the draft and its clean-label positioning.

items.title: FDA moves to revoke permission for some chemicals used in food dyes
items.summary: FDA moved to revoke authorisation for some solvent chemicals used to make food colour extracts.
items.why: Patisserie colours and decorations sold in the US should be checked for affected colour extracts with suppliers.

items.title: Considering impact of inclusions vital to product success
items.summary: Industry article on how inclusions affect bakery and snack product success.
items.why: Inclusions (chips, pieces, fruit) are a Puratos and Belcolade product area; useful for customer formulation support.
